name: TF3OpenAPI placement in two steps
description: With the game's own option "Enable Drag-and-Confirm Construction Mode" on (Settings, Advanced), stations, depots and other objects are placed in two steps too: the first click pins the object, holding the right mouse button and moving the mouse turns it in steps of 10 degrees, a second click builds it, a right click lets go of it. Needs the TF3OpenAPI native layer with [Placement] ConfirmObjects=1; without it nothing changes.
